meta.title: Cookie policy
meta.description: mobiera.io sets one essential cookie for your consent choice and, only if you accept, analytics cookies. No advertising cookies.

title: Cookie policy
lead: One essential entry for your consent choice, analytics only if you accept, no advertising cookies.

essential.title: Essential
essential.body: Your consent choice is stored in your browser's local storage for as long as you keep it. Your theme preference (light or dark) is stored the same way and never sent to us.

analytics.title: Analytics, with consent
analytics.body: Anonymized usage statistics through Google Analytics 4, set only after you accept, for 13 months.
